name: Refrag
what_it_is: A Counter-Strike 2 training and review platform with an AI coach, aim and utility trainers, scrims and a 2D demo viewer.
platforms: Web; on-demand practice servers in 26 listed locations
pricing: Core $5.83 per month billed annually ($8.50 monthly); Prime $11.5 per month annually ($15 monthly); Team $60 per month annually ($79 monthly) for 7 player slots.
notable: The page offers sign-up for free; paid tiers are listed.

facts.fact: Refrag says it explains why a player loses CS2 rounds, recommends training and builds routines from gameplay.
Refrag lists Core at $5.83 per month billed annually ($8.50 monthly), Prime at $11.5 ($15 monthly) and Team at $60 ($79 monthly) with 7 player slots.
Prime adds coach feedback after every match, scrims, Restrat, Utility Hub, detailed aim stats, a 2D demo viewer and Academy; Core lacks these.

name: Skybox Edge
what_it_is: A CS2 analytics, replay and team preparation platform sold to teams, with broadcast tools sold separately.
pricing: Tier 2 is EUR 350 per month or EUR 3,570 per year; Tier 1 is EUR 1,299 per month or EUR 11,400 per year; education licenses on request.
notable: Licensed by Valve Corporation, per the footer.

facts.fact: Skybox describes CS2 analytics, replays and broadcast tools, with Skybox Edge helping teams improve, prepare and play.
The footer names Skybox Technologies ApS, Copenhagen, Denmark, and says it is licensed by Valve Corporation.
Skybox lists Tier 2 at EUR 350 per month or EUR 3,570 per year and Tier 1 at EUR 1,299 per month or EUR 11,400 per year; Tier 1 adds Tactic-spotter AI, tactic filters and match reports.
Skybox says it offers licenses for schools and clubs running non-profit gaming programs.
